_label_legend.MEASURED: obtained by actually running our Python/PyTorch experiment (Steps 1-5)
_label_legend.DERIVED: computed mathematically from MEASURED or from the frozen architecture spec; no new experiment run
_label_legend.HYPOTHETICAL: illustrative/deployment-oriented figure requiring a real implementation choice not made or tested here
_label_legend.FUTURE_HARDWARE_WORK: requires hardware measurement we have not performed; never invented

post_gap_effective_coverage_samples.label: DERIVED
post_gap_effective_coverage_samples.note: GAP averages the entire remaining feature map (32 positions, jump 4); raw union-of-RFs value is 184 samples, capped at the true 128-sample input window

compute_rate_50pct_overlap_scheme.note: This is a THROUGHPUT figure for the current non-streaming, whole-window-recompute scheme; it is NOT an MCU cycle count, latency, or energy figure (see hardware_work_needed below).

int16_bandwidth_bytes_per_s.label: HYPOTHETICAL
int16_bandwidth_bytes_per_s.note: illustrative deployment-oriented sensor format; this project never used int16 input

quantization_storage_estimate.note: naive storage arithmetic only (1 byte/parameter); ignores per-channel scale/zero-point metadata, BN folding, and any other real quantization overhead; NOT an accuracy, latency, or energy claim

model_C_fp32_to_int8_ratio.label: DERIVED
model_C_fp32_to_int8_ratio.note: 1 byte / 4 bytes; i.e. a 75% reduction in raw weight storage

validation_macro_f1_gap.label: DERIVED
validation_macro_f1_gap.note: 0.9898 - 0.9890; within roughly one Phase-1 std (0.0005-0.0006) of either model
